random_selection.method: secrets.randbelow(6), executed once over independent authored concept pool
pool: university radio club outdoor live-broadcast rehearsal
university theater club paper-wave stage repair
university woodworking club festival booth sign balancing
university astronomy club daylight festival planetarium focus test
university art club long-cloth festival print preparation
university jazz club music-stand clamp repair

selected_concept: A university astronomy club tests a portable planetarium in a blackout festival booth during daylight. The reference-appearance protagonist adjusts the focus ring of a waist-high projector while a peer pulls a loose screen corner taut; crisp projected stars visibly reward the shared adjustment. An open booth side reveals the campus courtyard and student-union building.
independent_alternatives_compared: A posed astronomy-club portrait beside equipment would read the role but lose the shared practical stakes.
A night telescope observation would read astronomy but weaken festival-preparation and daytime campus evidence.
Chosen daylight blackout booth creates a visible outside/inside relationship and one cooperative test whose result is assessable.

must_show_together: campus courtyard or student union architecture
locating campus/university and astronomy-club sign cues
mandatory_full_visibility_gates.rule: All contextual parts must be legible together; generic festival or generic laboratory alone is partial.
Both actors and their distinct target contacts must be visible in the same photograph; guessed contact is partial.

must_show_together: projector housing and lens direction toward screen
visible star-dot projection on that screen
mandatory_full_visibility_gates.rule: A decorative star background detached from the device is insufficient.

must_show_together: short dark bob and wispy fringe
mandatory_full_visibility_gates.rule: Appearance comparison only; do not infer identity or actual age.

permitted_inputs: current coordinator task for workflow only

original_image_appearance_scope: face and hair only, partial appearance property anchors; original clothing and biography are not inherited
